title: Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum Review: Vitamin C + Pro-Vitamin D, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum: an overnight serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D that helps repair the moisture barrier while you sleep, for dehydration, hyperpigmentation and lackluster skin.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Overnight serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D (25 ml)
• Helps repair and restore the moisture barrier during sleep
• Long-lasting brightness and immediate hydration; helps reverse daytime damage
• For dehydration, hyperpigmentation, lackluster skin and a damaged moisture barrier
• After cleansing and toning, 3-4 drops over face and neck before bed, before moisturizer; keep out of eyes
• Sensitive skin can use it; patch test first if you know of a specific sensitivity; no artificial fragrance
